what: Mastercard runs the second-largest global card-payment network. Banks issue Mastercard-branded cards and Mastercard earns fees on the transactions that flow through its network.
customers: Banks and fintechs that issue cards, merchants, governments and billions of cardholders.
money: fees on transaction volume, processing and cross-border payments
fraud prevention, cyber security, data analytics and loyalty programs
moat: The same two-sided network effect as Visa, a global brand and high margins with low capital needs.
risks: Regulation of interchange and network fees
New payment rails that skip card networks
opportunities: Operating margin of 58% and return on invested capital of 55%
Revenue grew about 16% last year and about 14% a year over three years
Value-added services grow faster than payment processing and need no new network capacity
watch: Cross-border volume growth and value-added services revenue.
